BLOCKING: the pre-gel bar cannot be restored. Both pre-gel wells fail the script's own minSignal = 0.01 gate on blank-corrected A412, at -0.013 and -0.014. Among the ten matrix-only control wells the two pre-gel controls are the highest at BOTH wavelengths: 0.361 and 0.319 at 412 nm, 0.285 and 0.242 at 570 nm. The excess over the other eight controls is +0.146 at 412 nm and +0.091 at 570 nm, a ratio of 1.6, which is broadband scattering from a turbid medium and not absorbance near the 405 nm photopatterning wavelength. A reference read around 700 nm subtracted from both channels is the correction that would make this condition measurable.
The two versions of this figure rest on different numbers, and the numbers behind the five-bar version are not preserved in the current script.
